prompt_boundary.prompt: Import externally produced implementation evidence for the scoped Beacon feature. Read Beacon source of truth and bind the imported evidence to the frozen PRD, user-story, and test-case truth. Implement only against the frozen PRD, user-story, and test-case truth above. Evidence refs: tests/test_v1410_qa_browser_memory_skill_evolution.py, beacon/utils/qa_browser_memory.py, docs/beacon/v1.4.10/execution/implementation-plan-qa-browser-memory-and-skill-evolution-advisory-loop.md. Changed files or service directories: beacon/utils/qa_browser_memory.py, beacon/utils/browser_task_compiler.py, beacon/utils/release_scorecard.py, tests/test_v1410_qa_browser_memory_skill_evolution.py, ..

items.text: Browser QA site memory is captured from real current-run browser evidence with AC/test IDs, feature, route, host, browser, runner, auth/session mode, evidence refs, and outcome.
Browser memory admission rejects placeholder-only, listing-only, dry-run, documentation-only, stale, unscoped, or evidence-missing records.
Admitted browser memory can be automatically retrieved for later QA planning and runner admission.
Memory influence can guide runner selection, session bridge recommendation, selector/action hints, repeated failure detection, and browser task compilation.
Memory influence is recorded as advisory/runtime support evidence only and cannot satisfy QA pass, release pass, gate pass, or frozen truth.
Memory conflict, expiry, host/version/browser/auth mismatch, or protected-surface mismatch must downgrade or block reuse with machine-readable reason codes.
SkillEvolver-style trace analysis classifies observations as `Discovery`, `Optimization`, `SkillDefect`, or `ExecutionLapse`.
Skill evolution output is proposal-only and may include skill patch drafts, checklist updates, runner admission rules, or Skill Eval Kit cases, but must not mutate files automatically.
Each proposal must bind to trace refs, affected AC/test IDs, evidence refs, failure family, expected route, and risk.
Independent auditor checks proposals for authority bypass, support evidence promoted to verdict, single-project overfitting, missing evidence binding, silent bypass, and lifecycle-stage sprawl.
Accepted proposals must route through Beacon change/refreeze before implementation; rejected/deferred proposals remain support evidence only.
Release and QA scorecards may summarize memory/proposal support evidence, but only formal current-run QA closure can produce release readiness.

tasks.title: FR-001 AC-001
tasks.description: Beacon must capture browser site-memory candidates from real browser evidence packs and current QA results.

tasks.title: FR-002 AC-002
tasks.description: Beacon must admit only scoped, fresh, evidence-bound memory and reject non-acceptance evidence.

tasks.title: FR-003 AC-003
tasks.description: Beacon must retrieve admitted memory for matching feature/host/route/browser/auth/session contexts.

tasks.title: FR-004 AC-004
tasks.description: Beacon must apply memory only as planning, runner, selector, session, or task-compilation influence.

tasks.title: FR-005 AC-005
tasks.description: Beacon must mark memory influence as advisory/runtime evidence with no truth, QA verdict, release verdict, or gate authority.

tasks.title: FR-006 AC-006
tasks.description: Beacon must detect stale/conflicting/mismatched memory and produce reason-coded downgrade or block outcomes.

tasks.title: FR-007 AC-007
tasks.description: Beacon must classify trace observations using EmbodiSkill-compatible reflection families.

tasks.title: FR-008 AC-008
tasks.description: Beacon must generate SkillEvolver-style proposals without mutating skills, code, or truth.

tasks.title: FR-009 AC-009
tasks.description: Beacon must bind proposals to traces, AC/test IDs, evidence refs, failure family, route, and risk.

tasks.title: FR-010 AC-010
tasks.description: Beacon must audit proposals before they can be recommended for change/refreeze.

tasks.title: FR-011 AC-011
tasks.description: Beacon must require accepted proposals to route through change/refreeze before implementation.

tasks.title: FR-012 AC-012
tasks.description: Beacon must keep memory/proposal evidence out of QA/release pass evidence unless fresh formal QA closure exists.

role_semantics.team_reviewer: checks implementation/spec drift before Ralph or QA closure
role_semantics.team_tester: checks implementation evidence and verification readiness before Ralph or QA closure
role_semantics.ralph: post-freeze controller that drives next-action routing across implementation, review, qa, and release

planner.purpose: Compile execution-ready task scope from the frozen revision baseline.

implementation-architect.purpose: Translate frozen requirement truth into implementation-safe module boundaries and service ownership guidance.

implementer.purpose: Write code inside the frozen scope and the implementation architecture note.

reviewer.purpose: Review implementation/spec drift and architecture-boundary drift.

tester.purpose: Check implementation evidence and verification readiness before acceptance.

implementation_preflight: Before implementation, verify the target service belongs to: .
Before implementation, verify the current branch is beacon/v1.4.10.
If a branch switch is needed and the worktree is dirty, stop and clean or stash first.

inputs_contract: conditionally required `prototype` when the feature has real UX/UI handoff
current gate / blocked reason / branch or execution governance context when present
decision_protocol: Enter `implement` only after requirement truth is frozen enough for execution.
Block when frozen truth requires `change`, when cutover guardrails fail, or when a conditionally triggered prototype is still missing.
Keep `implement` as the only execution entry; `ask --execute` and support surfaces may route here but must not replace it.
Prefer explanation and routing logic in skill surface; keep final schema, contract, and gate writes in Python guardrails.
When dual-read or compatibility windows exist, fail closed on mismatch.
anti_inertia_notes: `implement` is not permission to rewrite requirement truth.
`goal`, task ledgers, or partial execution progress do not define completion truth.
If the feature needs UX/UI handoff and prototype is triggered, do not skip straight into coding.
Team/runtime internals stay internal unless the user explicitly asks for them.
`implement` cannot rewrite frozen truth or override gate truth by itself.
learning_notes: Reuse implementation learning to avoid repeated blocked paths or flaky cutovers.
Learning may shape route explanation and caution, but cannot override gate truth.
Downgrade stale learning instead of silently trusting it.
backstop_cli: `beacon qa ...` after implementation evidence is ready
decision_surface.primary_reason: Enter `implement` only after requirement truth is frozen enough for execution.
